40010653.author: पदार्थः
40010653.content: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तान् them, हरीन् monkeys, दक्षिणां दिशम् in the southernquarter, प्रस्थाप्य having sent, अथ now, मेघसङ्काशम्  resembling a cloud, सुषेणं नाम known as Sushena, यूथपम् troop leader, अब्रवीत् said.

40010653.author: Translation
40010653.content: After sending the monkeys in the southern direction, Sugriva said to the cloudlike troop leader called Sushena.

40010654.author: पदार्थः
40010654.content: राजा king, तारायाः Tara's, पितरम् father, श्वशुरम् his fatherinlaw, भीमविक्रमम् a hero of terrifying valour, अभिगम्य having gone, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, प्रणम्य च having offered salutation, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40010654.author: Translation
40010654.content: King (Sugriva) went with folded hands to Tara's father, his fatherinlaw, of terrifying valour, offered salutation and said:

40010655.author: पदार्थः
40010655.content: मरीचिपुत्रम् son of Marichi, मारीचम् Maricha, महाकपिम् great monkey, शूरैः with brave ones, कपिवरैः with best monkeys, वृतम् surounded, महेन्द्रसदृशद्युतिम् glowing like Mahendra, बुद्धिविक्रमसम्पन्नम् with wisdom and bravery, वैनतेयसमद्युतिम् equal to Garuda in lustre, अर्चिष्मन्तम् a person filled with lustre, मरीचिपुत्रान् sons of Maricha, अर्चिर्मालान् Archirmala's, महाबलान् valiant ones, ऋषिपुत्रांश्च sons of sages, सर्वान् all, मारीचान् Maricha's, प्रतीचीं दिशम् to western quarter, आदिशत् instructed.

40010655.author: Translation
40010655.content: Sugriva  spoke to the great lustrous monkey Archisman, son of the eminent sage Marichi who possessed the wisdom and prowess of Indra and was comparable to Vaineteya (Garuda) in lustre. He also spoke to the other sons of Maricha, called Marichas, who were very strong and known as Archismalas (garlands of continuous glow) and asked all of them to proceed in the western direction.

40010656.author: पदार्थः
40010656.content: मरीचिपुत्रम् son of Marichi, मारीचम् Maricha, महाकपिम् great monkey, शूरैः with brave ones, कपिवरैः with best monkeys, वृतम् surounded, महेन्द्रसदृशद्युतिम् glowing like Mahendra, बुद्धिविक्रमसम्पन्नम् with wisdom and bravery, वैनतेयसमद्युतिम् equal to Garuda in lustre, अर्चिष्मन्तम् a person filled with lustre, मरीचिपुत्रान् sons of Maricha, अर्चिर्मालान् Archirmala's, महाबलान् valiant ones, ऋषिपुत्रांश्च sons of sages, सर्वान् all, मारीचान् Maricha's, प्रतीचीं दिशम् to western quarter, आदिशत् instructed.

40010656.author: Translation
40010656.content: Sugriva  spoke to the great lustrous monkey Archisman, son of the eminent sage Marichi who possessed the wisdom and prowess of Indra and was comparable to Vaineteya (Garuda) in lustre. He also spoke to the other sons of Maricha, called Marichas, who were very strong and known as Archismalas (garlands of continuous glow) and asked all of them to proceed in the western direction.

40010657.author: पदार्थः
40010657.content: कपिसत्तमाः foremost of monkeys, यूयम् you, सुषेण प्रमुखाः having Sushena as leader, कपीनाम् among monkeys, द्वाभ्याम् with two, शतसहस्राभ्याम् hundred thousands, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, परिमार्गत: search.

40010657.author: Translation
40010657.content: 'O foremost of monkeys with Sushena as your group leader accompanied by two hundred thousand vanaras, go and search for Vaidehi.

40010658.author: पदार्थः
40010658.content: हरियूथपाः leaders of monkeys, सौराष्ट्रान् in the country of Saurashtra, तथैव च and similarly, सहबाह्लीकान् even in Bahlika, श्चन्द्रचित्रां in chandrachitra, स्फीतान् prosperous, रम्यान् delightful, जनपदान् villages, विपुलानि vast, पुराणि च towns, पुन्नागगहनम् punnaga grove, वकुलोद्दालकाकुलम्  haphazard distribution of punnaga, bakula and uddalaka trees, कुक्षिम् in kukshi, तथा similarly, केतकखण्डांश्च in Kethaka shrubs, मार्गध्वम् search.

40010658.author: Translation
40010658.content: 'O leaders of monkeys search for Sita in the countries of Saurashtra, and also Bahlika, Chandrachitra, in delightful villages and vast towns, also in Kukshi covered haphazardly with punnaga, bakula and uddalaka trees as well as ketaka shrubs.

40010659.author: पदार्थः
40010659.content: हरियूथपाः leaders of monkeys, सौराष्ट्रान् in the country of Saurashtra, तथैव च and similarly, सहबाह्लीकान् even in Bahlika, श्चन्द्रचित्रां in chandrachitra, स्फीतान् prosperous, रम्यान् delightful, जनपदान् villages, विपुलानि vast, पुराणि च towns, पुन्नागगहनम् punnaga grove, वकुलोद्दालकाकुलम्  haphazard distribution of punnaga, bakula and uddalaka trees, कुक्षिम् in kukshi, तथा similarly, केतकखण्डांश्च in Kethaka shrubs, मार्गध्वम् search.

40010659.author: Translation
40010659.content: 'O leaders of monkeys search for Sita in the countries of Saurashtra, and also Bahlika, Chandrachitra, in delightful villages and vast towns, also in Kukshi covered haphazardly with punnaga, bakula and uddalaka trees as well as ketaka shrubs.

40010660.author: पदार्थः
40010660.content: वानराः O monkeys, प्रत्यक्स्रोतोगमाः those flowing to the west, शीतजलाः cool waters, शिवाः sacred, नद्यश्चैव rivers too, तापसानां in hermits, अरण्यानि woods, ये those, कान्तारा: गिरयश्च forests and mountains, तत्र there, मरुप्रायाः dry, स्थलीं lands, अत्युच्चशिरसाः high peaks, शिलाःmountains, गिरिजालावृताम् surrounded by mountain ranges, दुर्गाम् inaccessible, दिशम् direction, मार्गित्वा after searching, पश्चिमां western side, ततः then, समुद्रम् the sea, पश्चिमम् the western, आसाद्य after reaching, द्रष्टुम् to see, अर्हथ it is proper for you, तिमिनक्रायुतजलम् water infested with whales and alligators, अक्षोभ्यम् which cannot be agitated, अथ then, वानराः monkeys.

40010660.author: Translation
40010660.content: 'O monkeys the auspicious rivers with cool waters flow towards the western region. Search in the groves inhabited by ascetics, other forests, mountains, cliffs, in the desertland. Search in the inaccessible western region surrounded by mountains. Then proceed to the western ocean infested with whales and alligators, which cannot be easily disturbed.

40010661.author: पदार्थः
40010661.content: वानराः O monkeys, प्रत्यक्स्रोतोगमाः those flowing to the west, शीतजलाः cool waters, शिवाः sacred, नद्यश्चैव rivers too, तापसानां in hermits, अरण्यानि woods, ये those, कान्तारा: गिरयश्च forests and mountains, तत्र there, मरुप्रायाः dry, स्थलीं lands, अत्युच्चशिरसाः high peaks, शिलाःmountains, गिरिजालावृताम् surrounded by mountain ranges, दुर्गाम् inaccessible, दिशम् direction, मार्गित्वा after searching, पश्चिमां western side, ततः then, समुद्रम् the sea, पश्चिमम् the western, आसाद्य after reaching, द्रष्टुम् to see, अर्हथ it is proper for you, तिमिनक्रायुतजलम् water infested with whales and alligators, अक्षोभ्यम् which cannot be agitated, अथ then, वानराः monkeys.

40010661.author: Translation
40010661.content: 'O monkeys the auspicious rivers with cool waters flow towards the western region. Search in the groves inhabited by ascetics, other forests, mountains, cliffs, in the desertland. Search in the inaccessible western region surrounded by mountains. Then proceed to the western ocean infested with whales and alligators, which cannot be easily disturbed.

40010662.author: पदार्थः
40010662.content: वानराः O monkeys, प्रत्यक्स्रोतोगमाः those flowing to the west, शीतजलाः cool waters, शिवाः sacred, नद्यश्चैव rivers too, तापसानां in hermits, अरण्यानि woods, ये those, कान्तारा: गिरयश्च forests and mountains, तत्र there, मरुप्रायाः dry, स्थलीं lands, अत्युच्चशिरसाः high peaks, शिलाःmountains, गिरिजालावृताम् surrounded by mountain ranges, दुर्गाम् inaccessible, दिशम् direction, मार्गित्वा after searching, पश्चिमां western side, ततः then, समुद्रम् the sea, पश्चिमम् the western, आसाद्य after reaching, द्रष्टुम् to see, अर्हथ it is proper for you, तिमिनक्रायुतजलम् water infested with whales and alligators, अक्षोभ्यम् which cannot be agitated, अथ then, वानराः monkeys.

40010662.author: Translation
40010662.content: 'O monkeys the auspicious rivers with cool waters flow towards the western region. Search in the groves inhabited by ascetics, other forests, mountains, cliffs, in the desertland. Search in the inaccessible western region surrounded by mountains. Then proceed to the western ocean infested with whales and alligators, which cannot be easily disturbed.

40010663.author: पदार्थः
40010663.content: ततः then, कपयः monkeys, केतकषण्डेषु in the ketaka shrubs, तमालगहनेषु च in the thickets of tamala trees, नारिकेलवनेषु च and in coconut groves, विहरिष्यन्ति roam.

40010663.author: Translation
40010663.content: 'There the monkeys may roam about the Ketaka shrubs, tamala thickets and coconut groves.

40010664.author: पदार्थः
40010664.content: तत्र there,वेलातलनिविष्टेषु among those on the sea shore tract, पर्वतेषु in mountains, वनेषु in groves, सीतां च Sita's, रावणस्य Ravana's, निलयं च  residence, मार्गध्वम् search, मुरचीपत्तनं चैव town of Murachi, रम्यम् beautiful, जटपुरं चैव and in the city of Jata, अवन्तीम् in Avanti, अङ्गलोपां च  in Angalopa city, तथा so also, अलक्षितम् unnoticed, वनम्  forest, ततस्ततः here and there, राष्ट्रणिच kingdoms, विशालानि vast, पत्तनानि towns

40010664.author: Translation
40010664.content: 'Look for Sita as well as the residence of Ravana.You should find the whereabouts of Sita in the mountains and forests located on the sea shore. Search in the city of Murachi, beautiful city of Jata, Avanti, Angalopa and in the unnoticed forestland. Look for her in the vast kingdoms and cities all over.

40010665.author: पदार्थः
40010665.content: तत्र there,वेलातलनिविष्टेषु among those on the sea shore tract, पर्वतेषु in mountains, वनेषु in groves, सीतां च Sita's, रावणस्य Ravana's, निलयं च  residence, मार्गध्वम् search, मुरचीपत्तनं चैव town of Murachi, रम्यम् beautiful, जटपुरं चैव and in the city of Jata, अवन्तीम् in Avanti, अङ्गलोपां च  in Angalopa city, तथा so also, अलक्षितम् unnoticed, वनम्  forest, ततस्ततः here and there, राष्ट्रणिच kingdoms, विशालानि vast, पत्तनानि towns

40010665.author: Translation
40010665.content: 'Look for Sita as well as the residence of Ravana.You should find the whereabouts of Sita in the mountains and forests located on the sea shore. Search in the city of Murachi, beautiful city of Jata, Avanti, Angalopa and in the unnoticed forestland. Look for her in the vast kingdoms and cities all over.

40010666.author: पदार्थः
40010666.content: तत्र there,वेलातलनिविष्टेषु among those on the sea shore tract, पर्वतेषु in mountains, वनेषु in groves, सीतां च Sita's, रावणस्य Ravana's, निलयं च  residence, मार्गध्वम् search, मुरचीपत्तनं चैव town of Murachi, रम्यम् beautiful, जटपुरं चैव and in the city of Jata, अवन्तीम् in Avanti, अङ्गलोपां च  in Angalopa city, तथा so also, अलक्षितम् unnoticed, वनम्  forest, ततस्ततः here and there, राष्ट्रणिच kingdoms, विशालानि vast, पत्तनानि towns

40010666.author: Translation
40010666.content: 'Look for Sita as well as the residence of Ravana.You should find the whereabouts of Sita in the mountains and forests located on the sea shore. Search in the city of Murachi, beautiful city of Jata, Avanti, Angalopa and in the unnoticed forestland. Look for her in the vast kingdoms and cities all over.

40010667.author: पदार्थः
40010667.content: सिन्धुसागरयोः of sindhu and the sea, सङ्गमे at the confluence, तत्र there, हेमगिरिर्नाम known as Hemagiri, शतशृङ्गःof hundred peaks, महाद्रुमःgreat trees,  पर्वतःmountain,

40010667.author: Translation
40010667.content: 'There is a lofty mountain with a hundred peaks and great trees at the confluence of river Sindhu and the sea. It is known as Hemagiri (golden mountain).

40010668.author: पदार्थः
40010668.content: तस्य its, रम्येषु beautiful, प्रस्थेषु slopes, पक्षगमाः with wings, सिंहाः lions, स्थिताः are sheltered, ते they, तिमिमत्स्यगजांश्चैव whales fishes and elephants from the sea, नीडानि in their shelters (caves), आरोपयन्ति place

40010668.author: Translation
40010668.content: 'On the slopes of that mountain you will find lions called Pakshagamas, that is lions with wings. They carry  the whales, fishes and elephants from the sea to their shelters on the beautiful mountain slopes.

40010669.author: पदार्थः
40010669.content: गिरिशृङ्गगताः roaming on the slopes, तोयदस्वननिस्वनाः sounding like thundering clouds, दृप्ताः proud, तृप्ताश्च satisfied, ये those, मातङ्गाः elephants, समन्ततः everywhere, तोयपूर्णे filled with water, अस्मिन् they, विशाले broad, सिंहानाम् lions', नीडानि in the dens, विचरन्ति roam about

40010669.author: Translation
40010669.content: 'The proud elephants wandering on the mountain slopes, and on the vast tract filled with water would be happy trumpeting like thundering clouds. They roam in the caves of lions.

40010670.author: पदार्थः
40010670.content: तस्य दिवस्पर्शम् touching the sky, चित्रपादपम् colourful trees, काञ्चनम् golden, शृङ्गम् peak, सर्वम् all, कामरूपिभिः by those who can assume any form, कपिभिः by monkeys, आशु at once , विचेतव्यम् look for carefully

40010670.author: Translation
40010670.content: 'The monkeys capable of assuming any form at their will should search the scraping peaks of the golden mountain (Himagiri) with colourful trees without delay.

40010671.author: पदार्थः
40010671.content: वानराः monkeys, तत्र there, गतां on reaching, समुद्रे तु in the end of the sea, पारियात्रस्य of Pariyatra, शतयोजनाम् hundred yojanas, काञ्चनीम् golden, दुर्दर्शाम् difficult to see  (because of its brilliance), कोटिम् tip, द्रक्ष्यथ you will see

40010671.author: Translation
40010671.content: 'O monkeys you will see the dazzling golden tip of a mountain called Pariyatra towards the end of the sea. It is extended over a hundred yojanas and  dificult to gaze because of its brilliance.

40010672.author: पदार्थः
40010672.content: तत्र there, तपस्विनाम् of seers, अग्निनिकाशानाम् blazing like fire, घोराणाम् terrific, कामरूपिणाम् who can assume any form, गन्धर्वाणाम् of gandharvas, चतुर्विंशत् twentyfour, कोट्यःcrores, वसन्ति reside

40010672.author: Translation
40010672.content: 'There dwell twentyfour crore of terrific gandharvas blazing like fire who can assume any form.They lead an ascetic life.

40010673.author: पदार्थः
40010673.content: सहस्रशः in thousands, समवेताः assembled together, प्रतीकाशाः appearing like, ते you, भीमविक्रमैः with very brave ones, वानरैः by monkeys, नात्यासादयितव्याः not to go very close to them, पावकार्चिःwith fire likeglow

40010673.author: Translation
40010673.content: 'Collected together in thousands, and radiating like fire, they live there. Even the very brave vanaras should not go close to them.

40010674.author: पदार्थः
40010674.content: तस्मात् देशात् from that country, प्लवङ्गमैः by monkeys, फलम् fruits, किञ्चित् a little, नादेयम् should not be taken, सत्त्ववन्तः courageous, महाबलाः strong, ते वीराः those heroes, दुरासदाः हि  difficult to go there, भीमविक्रमाः heroes of frightening bravery, ते they, तत्र there, फलमूलानि fruits and roots, रक्षन्ते keep protecting

40010674.author: Translation
40010674.content: 'You should not pluck any fruits from those woods, for courageous gandharvas protect the fruits of the trees. It is difficult to go there, for those heroes have frightening bravery.

40010675.author: पदार्थः
40010675.content: तस्मात् देशात् from that country, प्लवङ्गमैः by monkeys, फलम् fruits, किञ्चित् a little, नादेयम् should not be taken, सत्त्ववन्तः courageous, महाबलाः strong, ते वीराः those heroes, दुरासदाः हि  difficult to go there, भीमविक्रमाः heroes of frightening bravery, ते they, तत्र there, फलमूलानि fruits and roots, रक्षन्ते keep protecting

40010675.author: Translation
40010675.content: 'You should not pluck any fruits from those woods, for courageous gandharvas protect the fruits of the trees. It is difficult to go there, for those heroes have frightening bravery.

40010676.author: पदार्थः
40010676.content: तत्र there, यत्नश्च effort, कर्तव्यः should put in, जानकी Janaki, मार्गितव्या च and search, कपित्वम् monkeyish nature, अनुवर्तताम्  follow, तेभ्यः from them, भयम् fear, किञ्चित् a little, न हि not there

40010676.author: Translation
40010676.content: 'Exert yourself in your search for Janaki. Indeed there will be no fear from them, if you behave like normal monkeys in a natural way.

40010677.author: पदार्थः
40010677.content: प्लवङ्गमाः O monkeys, तत्र there, वैढूर्यवर्णाभः of the colour of Vaidurya, वज्रसंस्थानसंस्थितः strong as a diamond, नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णः with different trees and vines, श्रीमान् glorious, वज्रोनाम named Vajra, महागिरि: great mountain, तत्र there, योजनानां शतम् of hundred yojanas, समम् even, समुदितः extended, तत्र there, गुहाः cave, प्रयत्नेन with great effort, विचेतव्याः you may look for

40010677.author: Translation
40010677.content: '(Beyond) there  is a glorious mountain called Vajra of the colour of Vaidurya, hard as a diamond with different kinds of trees and vines.The  mountain extends evenly to a stretch of a hundred yojanas.There are caves in the mountain where you may look for her with due effort.

40010678.author: पदार्थः
40010678.content: प्लवङ्गमाः O monkeys, तत्र there, वैढूर्यवर्णाभः of the colour of Vaidurya, वज्रसंस्थानसंस्थितः strong as a diamond, नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णः with different trees and vines, श्रीमान् glorious, वज्रोनाम named Vajra, महागिरि: great mountain, तत्र there, योजनानां शतम् of hundred yojanas, समम् even, समुदितः extended, तत्र there, गुहाः cave, प्रयत्नेन with great effort, विचेतव्याः you may look for

40010678.author: Translation
40010678.content: '(Beyond) there  is a glorious mountain called Vajra of the colour of Vaidurya, hard as a diamond with different kinds of trees and vines.The  mountain extends evenly to a stretch of a hundred yojanas.There are caves in the mountain where you may look for her with due effort.

40010679.author: पदार्थः
40010679.content: समुद्रस्य of the sea, चतुर्भागे in the one fourth part, चक्रवान् नाम Chakravan, पर्वतः mountain, तत्र there, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, सहस्रारम् thousand spiked, चक्रम् wheel, निर्मितम् constructed

40010679.author: Translation
40010679.content: 'Then move to the fourth part (of the western sea) where you will see  a mountain called Chakravan occupying a quarter part of the sea.You will find there a thousandspiked wheel built by Visvakarma.

40010680.author: पदार्थः
40010680.content: तत्र there, पुरुषोत्तमः supreme Lord Visnu, हयग्रीवम् Hayagriva , दानवम् demon, हत्वा having killed, ततः then, चक्रम् discus, पञ्चजनम् Panchajanam, शङ्खं च conch, आजहार brought

40010680.author: Translation
40010680.content: 'It was there that the Supreme Lord Visnu, having slain Hayagriva and Panchajanam,  recovered the discus and conch for himself.

40010681.author: पदार्थः
40010681.content: तस्य its, चित्रेषु in colourful ones, सानुषु on the slopes, विशालासु in wide places, गुहासु च in the caves, रावणः Ravana, वैदेह्या सहा with Vaidehi, ततस्ततः here and there, मार्गितव्यः search for

40010681.author: Translation
40010681.content: 'Look for Vaidehi and Ravana in the wide caves and colourful slopes of the (Chakravan) mountain.

40010682.author: पदार्थः
40010682.content: अगाधे in the deep, वरुणालये in the sea,चतु:ष्षष्टिः sixtyfour, योजनानां of yojanas, सुवर्णशृङ्गः golden peaked, वराहो नाम called Varaha, पर्वतः mountain सु श्रीमान् illustrious

40010682.author: Translation
40010682.content: 'Plunge deep down into the sea and you will see a goldenpeaked mountain called Varaha, the residence of Varuna.It is extended over sixty four yojanas in the sea.

40010683.author: पदार्थः
40010683.content: तत्र there, पाग्ज्योतिषं नाम named Pragjyotisha, जातरूपमयम् full of gold, पुरम् city, यस्मिन् in it, दुष्टात्मा evilminded, नरको नाम named Naraka, दानवः demon, वसति dwells

40010683.author: Translation
40010683.content: 'On the (Varaha) mountain is the city called Pragjyotisha, which is full of gold.There lives the  evilminded demon Naraka.

40010684.author: पदार्थः
40010684.content: तत्र there, चित्रेषु  wonderful spots, सानुषु on slopes, विशालासु  wide, गुहासु च in caves also, रावणः Ravana, वैदेह्या सह with Vaidehi, ततस्ततः everywhere, मार्गितव्यः may be looked for

40010684.author: Translation
40010684.content: 'There all over the wonderful slopes and wide caves look for Vaidehi and Ravana.

40010685.author: पदार्थः
40010685.content: तम् that, काञ्चनान्तरनिर्दरः caves inside all covered with gold, तं शैलेन्द्रम् that lord of mountain, अतिक्रम्य after crossing, धाराप्रस्रवणायुतः with waterfalls, सर्वसौवर्णः all gold, पर्वतः mountain

40010685.author: Translation
40010685.content: Beyond that lord of mountains lies an all-golden mountain, its caves gilded within and abounding in cascading waterfalls.

40010686.author: पदार्थः
40010686.content: सर्वतः everywhere, गजाश्च elephants, वराहाश्च boars, सिंहाः lions, व्याघ्राश्च tigers, तेन by their, शब्देन sound, दर्पिताः puffed with pride, तम् them, सततम्  always, अभिगर्जन्ति will be roaring

40010686.author: Translation
40010686.content: On every side elephants, boars, lions and tigers, made proud by their own roaring, ceaselessly roar there.

40010687.author: पदार्थः
40010687.content: हरिहयः one who has tawnycoloured horses, श्रीमान् prosperous, पाकशासनः Pakasasana, महेन्द्रः Indra, यस्मिन् in that, सुरैः by gods, राजा king, अभिषिक्तः is consecrated, सः he, मेघवान्नाम Meghavan by name, पर्वतः mountain

40010687.author: Translation
40010687.content: 'Possessor of tawny horses, king Indra who killed demon Pakasasana was consecrated by gods at this mountain since known as Meghavan.

40010688.author: पदार्थः
40010688.content: महेन्द्रपरिपालितम् governed by Indra, तम् that, शैलेन्द्रम् lord of mountains, अतिक्रम्य after crossing, तरुणादित्यवर्णानि with the colour of the rising Sun, काञ्चनानि golden, षष्टि गिरिसहस्राणि sixty thousand mountains, सर्वतः everywhere, भ्राजमानानि shining, सुपुष्पितैः with blooming  flowers, जातरूपमयैःfull of gold, वृक्षैःtrees, शोभितानि enchanting, गमिष्यथ you will reach

40010688.author: Translation
40010688.content: 'On crossing the hill ruled by Indra you will reach the rows of sixty thousand mountains of gold shining like the brilliance of the rising Sun. The mountains glow with golden trees filled with bloom.

40010689.author: पदार्थः
40010689.content: महेन्द्रपरिपालितम् governed by Indra, तम् that, शैलेन्द्रम् lord of mountains, अतिक्रम्य after crossing, तरुणादित्यवर्णानि with the colour of the rising Sun, काञ्चनानि golden, षष्टि गिरिसहस्राणि sixty thousand mountains, सर्वतः everywhere, भ्राजमानानि shining, सुपुष्पितैः with blooming  flowers, जातरूपमयैःfull of gold, वृक्षैःtrees, शोभितानि enchanting, गमिष्यथ you will reach

40010689.author: Translation
40010689.content: 'On crossing the hill ruled by Indra you will reach the rows of sixty thousand mountains of gold shining like the brilliance of the rising Sun. The mountains glow with golden trees filled with bloom.

40010690.author: पदार्थः
40010690.content: तेषाम् among them, मध्ये in the midst, राजा king, मेरुः Meru, उत्तरपर्वतः northern mountain, स्थितः stands, पुरा earlier, शैलः mountain, प्रसन्नेन by the pleased ones, आदित्येन by  Aditya, दत्तवरः blessed

40010690.author: Translation
40010690.content: 'In the midst of the sixty thousand hills stands Meru, King of mountains. It is the northern mountain, blessed by the Sungod with a boon in the past.

40010691.author: पदार्थः
40010691.content: शैलेन्द्रःking of mountains, तेन by him, एवम् in that way, उक्तः has been told, त्वदाश्रयाःthose who shelter there, एव only, दिवा day, रात्रं च and night, मत्प्रसादात् by my grace, काञ्चनाः golden, भविष्यन्ति will be, ये those, वत्स्यन्ति reside, ते चापि they also, प्रभया with radiance, रक्ताश्च like red colour, काञ्चनप्रभाः have golden radiance, भविष्यन्ति will be, देवगन्धर्वदानवाः gods, gandharvas and demons

40010691.author: Translation
40010691.content: 'The Sungod said to mount Meru, 'By my grace all the trees and hillocks of this king of mountains will shine in golden red, the gods, gandharvas and demons who dwell here will have golden radiance '.

40010692.author: पदार्थः
40010692.content: शैलेन्द्रःking of mountains, तेन by him, एवम् in that way, उक्तः has been told, त्वदाश्रयाःthose who shelter there, एव only, दिवा day, रात्रं च and night, मत्प्रसादात् by my grace, काञ्चनाः golden, भविष्यन्ति will be, ये those, वत्स्यन्ति reside, ते चापि they also, प्रभया with radiance, रक्ताश्च like red colour, काञ्चनप्रभाः have golden radiance, भविष्यन्ति will be, देवगन्धर्वदानवाः gods, gandharvas and demons

40010692.author: Translation
40010692.content: 'The Sungod said to mount Meru, 'By my grace all the trees and hillocks of this king of mountains will shine in golden red, the gods, gandharvas and demons who dwell here will have golden radiance '.

40010693.author: पदार्थः
40010693.content: विश्वेदेवाश्च Visvadevas, वसवः Vasus, मरुतश्च Maruts दिवौकसः gods, पश्चिमां सन्ध्याम् in the evening twilight, उत्तमपर्वतम् king of mountains,मेरुम् Meru, आगम्य after coming over, आदित्यम् Sun, उपतिष्ठन्ति they serve, सूर्यः Sun, तैः by them, अभिपूजितः worshipped, सर्वभूतानाम् for all beings, अदृश्यः unseen, अस्तं पर्वतम् to the western mountain behind which the sun sets, गच्छति goes

40010693.author: Translation
40010693.content: The Visvadevas, Vasus, Maruts, and the gods reach Meru, this great king of mountains, in the evening twilight. Worshipped by them, the Sungod sets behind the mountain and becomes invisible to all beings.

40010694.author: पदार्थः
40010694.content: विश्वेदेवाश्च Visvadevas, वसवः Vasus, मरुतश्च Maruts दिवौकसः gods, पश्चिमां सन्ध्याम् in the evening twilight, उत्तमपर्वतम् king of mountains,मेरुम् Meru, आगम्य after coming over, आदित्यम् Sun, उपतिष्ठन्ति they serve, सूर्यः Sun, तैः by them, अभिपूजितः worshipped, सर्वभूतानाम् for all beings, अदृश्यः unseen, अस्तं पर्वतम् to the western mountain behind which the sun sets, गच्छति goes

40010694.author: Translation
40010694.content: The Visvadevas, Vasus, Maruts, and the gods reach Meru, this great king of mountains, in the evening twilight. Worshipped by them, the Sungod sets behind the mountain and becomes invisible to all beings.

40010695.author: पदार्थः
40010695.content: दिवाकरः Sun, मुहूर्तर्धेन in half a moment, योजनानाम् of yojanas, तानि those, दशसहस्राणि ten thousand, शिलोच्चयम् to the mountain ranges, शीघ्रम् swiftly, अभियाति reaches,

40010695.author: Translation
40010695.content: 'Crossing ten thousand yojanas swiftly in half a moment, the Sun touches the mount behind which he sets.

40010696.author: पदार्थः
40010696.content: तस्य its,शृङ्गे on the peak, प्रासादगणसम्बाधम् cluster of mansions, सूर्यसन्निभम् shining like Sun, महत्great, दिव्यम् wonderful, भवनम् building, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, विहितम् is built

40010696.author: Translation
40010696.content: 'There is a great divine abode glowing like the Sungod on the peak of the mountain.It is a cluster of mansions built  by Visvakarma.

40010697.author: पदार्थः
40010697.content: चित्रैः with colourful, नानापक्षिसमाकुलैः with flocks of different kinds of birds, तरुभिः with trees, शोभितम् enchanting, महात्मनः of great, पाशहस्तस्य one who holds the noose in hand, वरुणस्य Varuna's, निकेतम् residence

40010697.author: Translation
40010697.content: 'It is the residence of Varuna, who holds the noose in his hand.It is an enchanting place, full of trees attracting flocks of various birds.

40010698.author: पदार्थः
40010698.content: मेरुम् Meru, अस्तं च from Asta, अन्तरा between, दशशिराः ten peaks, जातरूपमयः golden, श्रीमान् shining, चित्रवेदिकः with wonderful altars, महान् great, तालः palm tree, भ्राजते shines

40010698.author: Translation
40010698.content: 'Between mount Asta (the mountain behind which the Sun sets) and Meru there is a shining golden palm tree with ten high peaks and wonderful altars around.

40010699.author: पदार्थः
40010699.content: सर्वेषु in all, तेषु दुर्गेषु in those inaccessible mountains, सरस्सु च in lakes, सरित्सु च in rivers, ततस्ततः every where, वैदेह्या सह along with Vaidehi, रावणः Ravana, मार्गितव्यः look for

40010699.author: Translation
40010699.content: 'Look for Vaidehi and Ravana all over those inaccessible mountains, lakes and rivers.

40010700.author: पदार्थः
40010700.content: धर्मज्ञः knower of dharma, स्वेन on his own, तपसा with penance, भावितः he is identified, ब्रह्मणा with Brahma, समः equal, मेरुसावर्णिः इत्येव known as Meru Savarna, ख्यातः popular, यत्र there, तिष्ठति lies

40010700.author: Translation
40010700.content: 'The sage Merusavarna, knower of dharma, famous for his penance and comparable to Brahma lives there with him on Meru.

40010701.author: पदार्थः
40010701.content: सूर्यसन्निभः glowing like the Sun, महर्षिः seer, मेरुसावर्णिः Merusavarna who glows like Meru, शिरसा with head, भूमौ touching ground, प्रणम्य bowing down, मैथिलीं Maithili प्रति with regard to  प्रवृत्तिम् information, प्रष्टव्यः enquire

40010701.author: Translation
40010701.content: 'Bow down, touch the feet of the seer Merusavarna, who glows like the Sun and then enquire from him about Sita.

40010702.author: पदार्थः
40010702.content: भास्करः Sun, जीवलोकस्य of the world of living beings, एतावत् to this extent, सर्वम् all, रजनीक्ष्ये at the end of the night, वितिमिरम् devoid of darkness, कृत्वा after doing, अस्तं पर्वतम् mountain behind which the sun sets, गच्छति reaches

40010702.author: Translation
40010702.content: 'The world of living beings is extended to this extent. The Sun dispels darkness at the end of the night and thereafter reaches the mountain behind which he sets (at the end of the day).

40010703.author: पदार्थः
40010703.content: वानरपुङ्गवाः O great monkeys, एतावत् to this limit, वानरैः by monkeys, गन्तुम् to go, शक्यम् possible, अभास्करम्  devoid of the Sun, अमर्यादं च without boundaries, ततः परम् beyond that, न जानीमः we do not know

40010703.author: Translation
40010703.content: 'O great monkeys you can go only up to that point. The Sun's rays do not extend beyond this and it has no boundaries.We do not know about the area beyond this limit.

40010704.author: पदार्थः
40010704.content: वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, रावणस्य Ravana's, निलयं च abode, अधिगम्य after finding out, अस्तं पर्वतम् Astha mountain, आसाद्य after reaching, मासे a month, पूर्णे in completion of, निवर्तत you may return

40010704.author: Translation
40010704.content: 'Go and find out Sita and the abode of Ravana. After this, return to the mountain behind which the Sun sets and come back on completion of a month.

40010705.author: पदार्थः
40010705.content: मासात् more than a month, ऊर्द्वम् beyond that, न वस्तव्यम् you should not stay, वसन् while staying, मम to me, वध्यः to be killed, भवेत् you may be, युष्माभिः by you सहैव along with you, मे my, शूरः brave, श्वशुरः fatherinlaw, गमिष्यति will go

40010705.author: Translation
40010705.content: 'If you tarry beyond a month, you will be slain. My fatherin law, the brave hero will go with your group.

40010706.author: पदार्थः
40010706.content: दिष्टकारिभिः by those who carry out orders, भवद्भि: by you, एतस्य his, सर्वम् all, श्रोतव्यम् listen, महाबाहुः strongarmed one, महाबलःvery strong, एषः he, मे my, श्वशुरः fatherinlaw, गुरुः teacher

40010706.author: Translation
40010706.content: 'You should obey him. You are meant to carry out his orders. He is not only my fatherinlaw but also a valiant, strong and powerful hero and my preceptor.

40010707.author: पदार्थः
40010707.content: विक्रान्ताः advancing heroes, सर्वः all, भवन्तश्चापि you too, प्रमाणम् leader, कर्मसु in performing, एनम् him, प्रमाणमेन as authority, संस्थाप्य having placed him, पश्चिमां दिशम् western quarter, पश्यध्वम् look for

40010707.author: Translation
40010707.content: 'My fatherinlaw will be your leader. His authority will be final in all matters. Accept his authority and look for Vaidehi in the western direction.
